summary: Iteration 16 verifies (a) Kanban task ASSIGNEE + DUE DATE, (b) 'My Tasks' dashboard widget shows assignee + due, sorted, done-excluded, clickable, and (c) admin Integrations tab exposes the SAME catalog + wizard as user page. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_task_assignee_admin_integrations.py — 12/12 PASS. Also re-ran test_refactor_regression.py (18/18 PASS). Frontend UI: alice creates project + task, board renders [data-testid=task-assignee-select] with Alice/Bob options, [data-testid=task-due-input]; selecting Bob + 2026-06-15 -> reload -> [data-testid=task-assignee-badge] shows 'Bob Stitch' and [data-testid=task-due-badge] shows 'Jun 15' (persistence verified). Dashboard [data-testid=my-tasks-widget] renders [data-testid=my-task-row] with project name 'TEST_ui_iter16 · Bob Stitch' and 'Due Jun 15'; click navigates to /projects/{id}/board. Admin Integrations tab: [data-testid=google-oauth-card] present, [data-testid=admin-connect-integrations] section renders IntegrationsManager with all 8 connectors (n8n, aws_s3, dropbox, google_drive, llm, mcp, email, custom); wizard opened for Custom App with wizard-name -> wizard-next -> wizard-method-basic -> fields -> wizard-connect -> 'Custom App connected' toast, and integration appears in admin's /api/admin/integrations list. Security: non-member (demo) gets 403 on PUT /api/tasks/{id}. Backend enriches list_tasks + my_tasks with assignee_name resolved from users collection. Cleanup performed (all TEST_ projects + integrations deleted).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/projects.py::_enrich_tasks — clean: single Mongo lookup per list call, N+1 avoided. Uses set + $in. Good.

TaskInput/TaskUpdate use Optional[str] for due_date — accepts empty string ('') from frontend when clearing. Backend stores as empty string not null; UI check `t.due_date &&` handles both. Consider validating ISO date format at Pydantic level for defensive coding (not blocking; current UI uses <input type=date> which enforces YYYY-MM-DD).

ProjectBoard.jsx cosmetic minor: assignee badge shows initial letter prefix appended to full name — the rendered text is 'BBob Stitch' because badge shows an avatar circle with first letter ('B') plus the full name ('Bob Stitch'). Visually the letter is inside a styled circle so it looks fine to a user, but any test relying on exact text of the badge should account for the leading initial letter. Not a bug — just noted.

Admin.jsx embeds <IntegrationsManager/> which itself calls GET /integrations and /integrations/catalog — same data as the user page. If admins ever want a distinction between 'admin-owned' vs 'user-owned', a separate list would be needed; current behaviour (admin manages its own connections) matches the spec: 'nothing is forced'.
File sizes: projects.py 229 lines, Admin.jsx 507 lines, Integrations.jsx 297 lines — all under 700-line threshold.
